portal_hypertension.title: Splenic Artery Embolization: Tips, Tricks, and Current Standards of Practice.
portal_hypertension.journal: Radiographics : a review publication of the Radiological Society of North America, Inc
portal_hypertension.authors: Khanolkar L, Fagel BM, Geanon D
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：脾动脉栓塞术（SAE）是脾外伤患者手术治疗的替代方法，并且由于脾切除术存在感染风险而迅速流行起来。 临床提示：脾脏是腹腔内重要的器官，在造血和免疫功能中发挥作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The spleen is a vital intra-abdominal organ that provides a role in hematopoietic and immunologic functions. It is highly vascular and is the most commonly injured organ in the setting of blunt trauma, potentially leading to life-threatening hemoperitoneum. Splenic artery embolization (SAE) serves as an alternative to operative management of patients with splenic trauma and has quickly become popular given the infectious risks associated with splenectomy. Since its inception, indications for SAE have evolved beyond the management of traumatic injury. portal_hypertension.title: Imaging features of porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder in a case-control study: diagnostic value for differentiation from liver cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery
portal_hypertension.authors: Song F, Zhu H, Qian L
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：本研究进行了盲法、独立的影像学审查，以识别和比较两种疾病之间的独特影像学特征，并开发和验证区分 PSVD 和肝硬化的预测模型。 临床提示：由于临床表现和影像学特征重叠，门窦血管疾病 (PSVD) 经常被误诊为肝硬化。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) is often misdiagnosed as liver cirrhosis due to overlapping clinical presentations and imaging features. This study conducted a blinded, independent imaging review to identify and compare the distinct imaging features between the two diseases, and to develop and validate a predictive model for differentiating PSVD from cirrhosis. Patients with histologically and clinically confirmed PSVD or cirrhosis and available contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans were retrospectively enrolled in the study.
